source.notes: Scanned school paper; the embedded text layer is corrupt (broken font encoding), so text was OCR'd and corrected against the page images. Printed session 'Final Term Examination 2017-2018'; examYear taken as the later year. The 'Time :' field is printed blank, so durationMinutes is null. All 15 questions are compulsory (no choice printed). The circuit diagram for Q.14 is missing from the scan (blank space on page 3).
